<h2>How I supervise</h2>
<p>I aim to help students sharpen a clear research question, choose a method that can answer it, and communicate the result to people who can use it. As principal supervisor I take lead responsibility for the candidate's programme; as co-supervisor I usually contribute health-economics, behavioural, or choice-modelling expertise.</p>

<h2>Prospective students</h2>
<p>If you would like to discuss supervision, please send a CV setting out your academic qualifications, GPA or grading information, research experience, and any publications, together with a short note on the questions you would like to work on. Supervision is selective and depends on fit with current projects.</p>
<p class="inline-links"><a href="/contact/">Contact for supervision enquiries</a><a href="/research/">Research areas</a></p>
